similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the Earle Cabell Federal Building. It captures the massive, blocky modernist design with a prominent pinkish-brown granite base, a tall main tower body characterized by alternating vertical white marble piers and dark glass window strips, and a distinctive recessed top attic story with deep vertical columns. The model is fully enclosed and symmetric, ensuring 360-degree structural integrity without any gaps or Z-fighting.
